results.description: PROPOSED -> NEGOTIATING -> APPROVED_FOR_DISPATCH -> STAMPED -> DISPATCHED -> IN_FLIGHT -> RESULT_RECEIVED -> VERIFIED -> CLOSED
Alternative states (QUESTION, CONFLICT, BLOCKED, HUMAN_GATE, CANCEL) work correctly
First task acquires writer lease on scope path
Second task overlapping scope is placed on HOLD, not dispatched
Follow-up arriving while task is IN_FLIGHT cannot mutate in-flight task
Task fingerprint and command cannot be tampered with after STAMPED/DISPATCHED
Version increment explicitly links supersedes and superseded_by
